headlines.description: Arsenal struck twice in eight second-half minutes to secure a comeback 2-1 win against Leeds at the Emirates Stadium and move level on points with Manchester City at the Premier League summit.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal come from behind to overcome Leeds

headlines.description: Kristoffer Ajer's second-half equaliser ensured Brentford continued their unbeaten start to the Premier League season in an entertaining 2-2 draw at Aston Villa.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brentford stay unbeaten after compelling Villa draw

headlines.description: Jordan Henderson was the unlikely hero as Chelsea's entertainers blew Bournemouth away in a comprehensive and chaotic 5-1 win at Stamford Bridge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henderson, 36, nets unlikely brace as Chelsea thrash B'mouth

headlines.description: Ipswich produced a dramatic turnaround to beat Fulham 2-1 after late goals by Abdoul Ouattara and Dara O'Shea extended Alvaro Arbeloa's winless start to six Premier League matches.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ipswich bag late dramatic victory against Fulham

headlines.description: Maxim De Cuyper and Jaouen Hadjam were both on the scoresheet as 10-man Brighton clinched a 2-0 win over Sunderland at the Stadium of Light.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brighton keep pressure on City, Arsenal with win

headlines.description: Dominic Solanke capitalised on weak Manchester United defending as winless Tottenham recovered from Rodrigo Bentancur's dismissal to snatch a late 1-1 draw as boos filled Old Trafford once again.
headlines.shortLinkText: Solanke rescues point for 10-man Spurs as hapless Man United flatter to deceive again

headlines.description: Crystal Palace dealt former boss Oliver Glasner a blow after they bounced back to beat Nottingham Forest 3-1 on the Austrian's first return to Selhurst Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palace come from behind to beat Forest 3-1 and spoil Oliver Glasner's return to Selhurst Park

headlines.description: Hull retained their unbeaten home record since returning to the Premier League with an entertaining 2-2 draw against Everton at the MKM Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Belloumi maintains Hull's unbeaten home record

headlines.description: Uncertainty may surround Manchester City's future but nothing changed for them on the pitch as the Premier League leaders successfully came through their first public examination since their guilty verdicts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manchester City beat Liverpool with ease in first match after guilty verdicts

headlines.description: Coventry City picked up their first home victory in the Premier League for 25 years with an emphatic 4-1 win over Newcastle United on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coventry stun Newcastle with emphatic 4-1 win

events.name: Crystal Palace at Brighton & Hove Albion
Brighton & Hove Albion at Manchester City
